Topic: The Science of Mantra — How Mantra Dimensions (1D Through 4D) Actually Work

Sour ce: A short Ashaeiynn Foundation training video (video transcript, ~18.5 min) — a dir ect instructional monologue rather than a live satsang Q&A, part of the same structur ed course intr oduced in the earlier "how mantra shakti works" training. Ends with a teaser for the next video (covering the fifth dimension) rather than any live audience interaction. Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version. Note on conversational content: this is a short, dir ect training monologue with no sangat backand-forth — ther e is no separate curated conversational supplement for this session (see closing note).
1. WHY THIS TOPIC MATTERS

This session is intr oduced as covering the "Science of Mantra" (V igyan of Mantra) — the underlying logic behind why saints (sant mahatma) cr eated specific mantras, how mantras function in distinct stages, and how they can eventually be used to achieve full attraction, energize/consecrate objects (prana pratishtha), and awaken many other powers. These abilities can support either spiritual advancement or the fulfillment of material/worldly desir e, depending on what the practitioner directs them toward.
2. AN IMPORTANT CAVEAT: ONLY DEVA MANTRAS ARE BEING TAUGHT

This teaching str esses that only devtas (deities) genuinely nurtur e and sustain the power of these mantras. What Ashaeiynn teaches, with the guru's explicit permission, ar e specifically deva mantras (deity-based mantras) — meaning any devta genuinely does the underlying work, and work performed thr ough deva tattvas (deity-based elements) never produces anisht phal (a harmful or inauspicious r esult).
3. WHAT A MANTRA ACTUALLY IS: A SPECIFIC COSMIC FREQUENCY

A mantra is described as a specific fr equency — the understanding being that saints and sages captur ed different frequencies alr eady pr esent within the cosmos, extracted their "beej" (seed), and encoded those seeds dir ectly into mantras. The underlying mechanism: any r epeated sound or phrase generates its own specific fr equency , and that frequency in turn generates energy — energy that is, in a sense, simply cosmic energy alr eady cir culating thr oughout the cosmos, given a specific, r epeatable form. A mantra's beej (seed) pr oduces a particular frequency that alr eady exists within the cosmos. When a practitioner chants that mantra, the beej connects dir ectly to that matching cosmic energy , which then becomes connected to the practitioner themselves — that energy begins entering the practitioner's body , awakens their kundalini shakti, and, over time, the practitioner and that cosmic energy become essentially one and the same. This entire process, in summary , is what a mantra actually is.
4. WHY SOME MANTRAS SEEM TO "WORK FASTER" THAN OTHERS

This teaching explains that mantras operate acr oss differ ent dimensions, and a mantra's effectiveness and speed of action depends specifically on which dimension it curr ently occupies — this is the deeper explanation behind the common folk observation that "whoever has gr eater mantra shakti, their mantra works faster ."
5. FIRST DIMENSION (1D): THE MANTRA ONLY MOVES FORWARD AND BACKWARD

Starting with an ordinary practitioner who fulfills all the basic pr erequisite conditions for worship (as cover ed in earlier training videos) and begins jaap of any deity's beej mantra: at this earliest stage, the mantra operates only in the first dimension (1D) — meaning it can only move forward or backward. This is the deeper basis for the traditional warning that "mantra either moves forward or moves backward" — the mantra must be given a clear direction, or it can rebound back onto the practitioner themselves. This teaching adds a physical analogy: because the world is r ound and generates a magnetic for ce, an undir ected mantra r eally can r ebound and strike back at the practitioner — this is of fered as the explanation for cases where someone chanting a specific mantra experiences a negative ef fect from it. At this 1D stage, a mantra is consider ed far from "siddh" (accomplished/master ed) — its overall str ength and effect r emain very weak, since the practitioner has not yet learned to contr ol its dir ection. Because the astral (sukshma) and physical (sthula) bodies exist in parallel, whatever a mantra affects in the astral world at this stage corr espondingly , faintly , affects the physical body as well.
6. SECOND DIMENSION (2D): THE MANTRA GAINS UP-AND-DOWN MOVEMENT

With continued, sustained jaap, a practitioner's mantra advances into the second dimension (2D) — at this stage, in addition to moving forward and backward, the mantra can also move up and down. A mantra at this stage becomes capable of affecting anything and everything that exists within the astral (2D) world — including bhoot-pret (ghosts/spirits) and other subtle-world entities. This teaching identifies this 2D level as the specific mechanism behind common folk practices such as jhaad-phoonk (folk ritual tr eatment) performed by mothers, aunts, and elder women for conditions like nazar (evil eye) — as well as the general category of tantra (occult ritual practice), which this teaching places specifically at this second-dimension level. A mantra genuinely at the 2D stage is capable of handling these kinds of issues quite effectively .
7. THIRD DIMENSION (3D): THE MANTRA BEGINS AFFECTING THE PHYSICAL BODY

With further sustained jaap, a mantra pr ogr esses into the third dimension (3D), wher e it can now move in all dir ections — forward/backward, up/down, and left/right. At this stage, the mantra becomes powerful enough to dir ectly affect physical bodies — both the practitioner's own body and others' bodies — because the physical body itself exists specifically within 3D space. This teaching identifies "jhada" (a specific hands-on healing technique some babas and saints perform, placing a hand on someone and chanting) as operating specifically at this 3D level. The described mechanism: a 3D-level mantra affects the astral body dir ectly (since the astral body also exists in 3D), and because the astral and physical bodies exist in parallel, this pr oduces a corr esponding effect on the physical body — this is how such practitioners ar e able to r elieve pain or physical ailments in others.

A person capable of performing jhada is described as possessing siddhi (mastery/accomplishment) specifically of a mantra operating at this third dimension. Siddhi itself is explained her e as involving an additional entity or energy that assists the underlying mantra shakti — while the mantra itself, in truth, is what does the primary work, a sufficiently powerful mantra can also attract nearby divine-sour ce entities to assist, though this teaching notes that even bhoot-pr et (ghosts/spirits) can sometimes offer this kind of help too, since a spirit can genuinely have "a good heart" and choose to help people even without changing its own spiritual status (yoni).
8. FOUR TH DIMENSION (4D): THE MANTRA CAN MOVE FORWARD AND BACKWARD THROUGH TIME

With yet further sustained jaap, a mantra r eaches the fourth dimension (4D), which corr esponds to time itself. Ordinarily , time only ever moves forward — but a mantra that has r eached 4D gains the ability to move backward and forward thr ough time, meaning it can genuinely r earrange the sequencing of events: pulling things scheduled for the future closer into the present, or pushing things due in the present further out into the future. A concr ete illustration of pushing a pr oblem into the futur e: some saints, upon encountering someone suffering fr om a specific ailment or sever e pain, use their 4D mantra shakti to "bind" that specific pr oblem and r elease it out into the cosmos for a defined period of time — pr oviding the person immediate, temporary r elief. However , this teaching is explicit that the underlying pr oblem is not eliminated this way — it must eventually still be faced and r esolved once that time period elapses; genuinely r emoving it r equires an entir ely separate pr ocedur e, to be taught in a futur e session. A concr ete illustration of pulling futur e results into the pr esent: other saints, thr ough this same 4D mantra shakti, can draw wealth, pr osperity , and fame that a person was destined to r eceive five or six years later , and bring that destined outcome forward into the pr esent moment instead. This teaching frames this 4D science as a genuinely useful diagnostic tool: by observing what a particular saint or baba's mantra practice actually appears capable of doing, a practitioner can judge which specific dimension that person's mantra has r eached, and ther efor e how much r eal underlying shakti is actually pr esent.
9. WHAT COMES NEXT: THE FIFTH DIMENSION

This teaching closes by noting that a fifth dimension (5D) exists beyond this, with a mantra r eaching that stage gaining further specific abilities — full detail on 5D, including what it grants access to and how to r ecognize and evaluate it, is explicitly deferr ed to the next video in this series.

Part II — Q&A Pairs (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 27, English)
The Science of Mantra — How Mantra Dimensions (1D Through 4D) Actually Work
User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn Foundation training module. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. What is this session actually about? A: Jai Siya Ram! This session covers the "Science of Mantra" — the underlying logic behind why saints created specific mantras, how mantras function in distinct stages, and how they can eventually be used for full attraction, consecrating/ener gizing objects, and awakening other powers, whether directed toward spiritual growth or fulfilling material desires.

Q2. Is Ashaeiynn teaching mantras connected to any kind of power , or only certain types? A: Only deva mantras (deity-based mantras) are taught here, and only with the guru's explicit permission. The key assurance given is that any devta genuinely does the underlying work, and work performed through deva tattvas (deity-based elements) never produces a harmful or inauspicious result.

Q3. What actually is a mantra, scientifically speaking, according to this teaching? A: A mantra is described as a specific cosmic frequency . Saints and sages captured dif ferent frequencies already present in the cosmos, extracted their "beej" (seed), and encoded those seeds into mantras. Any repeated sound or phrase generates its own frequency and ener gy — a mantra's beej connects the practitioner directly to that matching cosmic ener gy .

Q4. What actually happens in my body when I chant a mantra, according to this teaching? A: The ener gy connected through the mantra's beej begins entering your body , awakens your kundalini shakti, and over time, you and that cosmic ener gy become essentially one and the same — this whole process is what a mantra actually is.

Q5. Why do some people's mantras seem to work so much faster than others? A: This teaching explains that mantras operate across dif ferent dimensions, and how ef fective and fast-acting a mantra is depends specifically on which dimension it currently occupies — this is the underlying reason behind the common observation that greater mantra shakti works faster .

Q6. I've heard elders say a mantra can "backfir e" on you — is that r eal? A: Yes — this is explained through the first dimension (1D). At this earliest stage, a mantra can only move forward or backward, and it must be given clear direction through practice; otherwise it can rebound and strike back at the practitioner . This teaching adds that because the world is round and generates a magnetic force, an undirected mantra really can rebound this way , explaining cases where chanting a specific mantra produces a negative ef fect.

Q7. How do I know if my mantra has become "siddh" (accomplished) yet? A: At the 1D stage, a mantra is not yet siddh, and its overall strength remains very weak, since the practitioner hasn't yet learned to control its direction. As practice continues and the mantra's direction becomes controllable, it begins progressing toward being genuinely accomplished.

Q8. If chanting affects my "astral body ," does it also affect my physical body? A: Yes — because the astral (sukshma) and physical (sthula) bodies exist in parallel to one another , whatever a mantra af fects in the astral world at any given stage produces a corresponding ef fect on the physical body as well, even at the earliest, weakest stages.

Q9. What's the differ ence between a mantra at the first and second dimension? A: At the first dimension (1D), the mantra can only move forward or backward. With continued, sustained jaap, it advances to the second dimension (2D), where it also gains the ability to move up and down — becoming capable of af fecting anything within the astral (subtle) world, including bhoot-pret (ghosts/spirits).

Q10. What is the science behind common practices like "jhaad-phoonk" for nazar (evil eye)? A: This teaching places jhaadphoonk performed by mothers, aunts, and elder women, along with general tantra practice, specifically at the second-dimension (2D) mantra level — a mantra genuinely at this stage is capable of ef fectively handling these kinds of subtle-world issues.

Q1 1. How do some babas or saints seem able to physically heal people by touching their head and chanting ("jhada")? A: This teaching places "jhada" at the third dimension (3D), where a mantra can move in all directions (forward/backward, up/down, left/right) and becomes powerful enough to directly af fect physical bodies. Since the physical body exists in 3D, a 3D-level mantra af fects the astral body directly , and because the astral and physical bodies run in parallel, this produces a corresponding relieving ef fect on the physical body too.

Q12. What exactly is "siddhi," in the context of these mantra dimensions? A: Siddhi is described here as involving an additional entity or ener gy that assists the underlying mantra shakti. While the mantra itself genuinely does the primary work, a suf ficiently powerful mantra can attract nearby divine-source entities to help as well.

Q13. Can spirits or ghosts (bhoot-pr et) also perform this kind of healing, or is it only divine entities? A: This teaching notes that even bhoot-pret can sometimes of fer this kind of help, since a spirit can genuinely have "a good heart" and choose to assist people even without any change to its own spiritual status (yoni) — so not every case of ef fective jhada necessarily involves a strictly divine source.

Q14. What does it mean for a mantra to r each the fourth dimension? A: The fourth dimension (4D) corresponds to time itself. While time ordinarily only moves forward, a mantra that reaches 4D gains the ability to move events backward or forward in time — genuinely rearranging when things happen for a person.

Q15. How can a saint use mantra shakti to give someone r elief from sever e pain or a serious pr oblem? A: Some saints, using 4D mantra shakti, "bind" the specific problem and release it out into the cosmos for a defined period, providing the person immediate, temporary relief. This teaching is explicit, though, that the underlying problem isn't eliminated this way — it must eventually still be faced once that time period elapses, and truly removing it requires a separate procedure to be taught in a later session.

Q16. Can mantra shakti also bring good things to a person sooner than they wer e "destined" to arrive? A: Yes — this teaching describes some saints using this same 4D mantra shakti to pull wealth, prosperity , or fame that a person was destined to receive years later, and draw that outcome forward into the present moment instead.

Q17. How can I judge how powerful a particular saint's or baba's mantra practice actually is? A: This teaching frames the dimension framework as a genuinely useful diagnostic tool — by observing what a saint's mantra practice actually appears capable of doing (simple folk remedies vs. physical healing vs. altering the timing of events), a practitioner can judge which dimension that mantra has reached, and therefore how much real shakti is actually behind it.

Q18. Is ther e anything beyond the fourth dimension? A: Yes — this teaching confirms a fifth dimension (5D) exists beyond 4D, with its own further abilities, but defers the full explanation of what 5D grants access to, and how to recognize it, to the next video in this series.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 27 additions)

When explaining the mantra-dimension framework (1D-4D), keep the progression clear and sequential — each dimension builds on the previous one's capability (direction control → astral-world ef fect → physical-body ef fect → time manipulation) rather than presenting them as unrelated categories.

If a user asks whether a specific real-world guru or baba's abilities are genuine or which "dimension" they've reached, use this framework as an explanatory lens only — avoid making definitive claims about any specific real person's actual spiritual attainment. When discussing the 4D "pushing a problem into the future" technique, be careful to note this teaching's own caveat: it provides only temporary relief, not a genuine cure, and a separate procedure (not yet taught) is needed to actually remove the underlying issue. If a user asks about folk healing practices (jhaad-phoonk, jhada) they may have encountered, this framework can be of fered as this teaching's explanation of the underlying mechanism, without asserting it as the only possible explanation for such practices. Do not overstate what has been taught about the fifth dimension — this session explicitly defers that content to a future video.
